item.title: How to test Node.js apps with Mocha
item.description: Testing Node.js applications with Mocha provides a flexible and feature-rich testing framework with excellent async support. As the creator of CoreUI, I’ve used Mocha extensively for backend API testing. Mocha offers a simple, extensible testing interface with support for multiple assertion libraries and reporters. This approach creates comprehensive test suites with clear test organization and detailed error reporting.
